steps.title: Create Composio auth config with own credentials
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and add it as a Redirect URL in the Slack app. Create the auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: A test connection to Slack completes via Composio.

steps.title: Create Slack app and set minimal scopes
steps.detail: Create the app, add the smallest set of scopes in app settings, and copy the client ID and secret from the App Management page.
steps.done_when: App exists with client ID, secret and a Redirect URL.

steps.title: Enable unlisted distribution
steps.detail: In Manage Distribution, complete the checklist and click Activate Public Distribution.
steps.done_when: Add to Slack button and shareable URL are available.

steps.title: Draft scope justifications and review materials
steps.detail: Write per-scope reasons explaining how the app uses each one, an architecture diagram, and a demo script covering install, OAuth, use and uninstall.
steps.done_when: Justifications and demo script are ready for review.

steps.title: Record demo, prepare listing and legal pages
steps.detail: Record the video, create 1600x1000 images, and publish privacy policy, landing and support pages. Provide a security contact and test accounts.
steps.done_when: All listing fields and pages are complete.

steps.title: Grow to 10 active workspaces
steps.detail: Get 10 workspaces that used the app in the past 28 days, and test the service on them.

steps.title: Submit to the Slack Marketplace
steps.detail: Submit from the Submit to the Slack Marketplace section, after fixing automated test issues.

steps.title: Wait for preliminary and functional review
steps.detail: Respond to feedback quickly. In the preliminary stage, each resubmission resets your queue place.
steps.done_when: All feedback addressed and app approved.

steps.title: Publish the approved app
steps.detail: After approval you choose when to publish. Update OAuth URLs for any new scopes.
steps.done_when: App is listed and installable from the Marketplace.
